Ethan —

Quick replies inline below, and attaching a version of our onboarding checklist filled with high-level options.

- Escrowed weights: we prefer not to require escrow for most community models; verified S3 access with signed URLs and a reproducible hash is acceptable for the first wave. If a publisher requests escrow we can support it for enterprise catalog items.
- Persistent copies: Redwood's partner gateway supports two modes — proxy-only (no persistent copy) and cached replication (encrypted object stores with KMS). For embargoed models we can default to proxy-only until embargo lifts.

Camila — can you outline the coop revenue split options and what Orchard's embargo + attribution asks mean for distribution UI/metadata?

Next steps:
1) Camila to propose coop terms and attribution language
2) Jordan to share integration checklists and health-check requirements
3) Ethan to confirm Priya for infra details and sign the NDA link we’ll send

Thanks,
Naomi

Subject: Re: OrchardAI model gateway onboarding — draft coop terms and attribution

Hi all —

Draft coop terms (summary):
- Revenue split: default 70/30 (publisher 70%) for hosted usage routed through Redwood gateway. Option to renegotiate for enterprise commitments.
- Attribution: Publisher name + link in model metadata; consumer-facing UI will show OrchardAI as provider; we can honor additional attribution text provided by Orchard up to 120 chars.
- Embargo handling: Redwood will support proxy-only mode for embargo period; we recommend a max 90-day embargo by default; anything longer requires exceptional approval.
- Weights redistribution: For community-licensed models we allow redistribution to downstream partners with attribution; for any model with a non-commercial/closed clause, redistribution is prohibited and must be proxied.
- Audit & logging: Redwood will provide per-request logging and an opt-in audit package for publishers requiring extended retention (paid add-on).

Legal redlines (high level) — we suggest:
- Clarify indemnity carve-outs for publisher-provided third-party data
- Narrow the definition of "redistribution" to avoid accidental exposures when caching

Ethan — attaching a version with inline legal notes (nda_orchard_signed.pdf is placeholder if you forward signed NDA).

Camila Reyes
Head of Publisher Partnerships | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: coop_terms_draft.docx, legal_notes_inline.pdf

From: OrchardAI Legal <legal@orchardai.com>

Subject: Re: OrchardAI model gateway onboarding — legal questions on redistribution clause

Camila / Naomi —

Thanks for the clear summary. A couple of items from OrchardAI legal before we sign off:

1) Redistribution carve-out: we need explicit language that disallows any redistribution to commercial product resellers without prior written consent. Non-commercial research redistribution is fine.
2) Embargo exceptions: Orchard requests a 120-day embargo option for models flagged as "experimental" by our release policy — would Redwood accept a 120-day exception with quarterly check-ins?
3) Attribution: request that any UI attribution link be configurable to point to our release notes page (we’ll provide canonical URLs).

If we can incorporate those three items into the coop terms we can circulate a signed addendum. Priya (our infra lead) will follow up separately on S3 access patterns and signed-URL TTLs.

Regards,
OrchardAI Legal
